name: Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, DECEMBER 9, 2020 -
06:00 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Oral Communications will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Oral Communication items will be referred to the City Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Public Comments will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
*If a public hearing item is part of the consent calendar, the public hearing shall be deemed held if the item is not removed from the consent calendar for discussion and possible action.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the November 16, 2020 Special Meeting, and the November 18, 2020 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2020-12-09 Item 08A Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Analyst McShane
Approve the Warrants.
2020-12-09 Item 08B Warrants
8C.
Authorization to continue utilizing U.S. Bank's Voyager Fleet Card for fuel purchasing. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Wilson
Authorize continued participation in the State of California's Fleet Card program by approving the Participating Addendum No. 7-16-99-27 Amendment 2 (Attachment 1 of the agenda report) with U.S. Bank National Association effective January 1, 2021 through June 30, 2021 subject to review of the City Attorney.
2020-12-09 Item 08C Voyager Renewal
8D.
Rejection of Bids for Heating, Ventilation, and Air Conditioning (HVAC) Systems Maintenance and proceed to rebid a future date. Authorize the extension of existing contract while rebidding occurs. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Wilson
1) Reject all bids for the HVAC Systems Maintenance and Replacement Agreement and rebid at a future date; and 2) Authorize the City Manager, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute Amendment No. 3 to the Contract for Maintenance of Mechanical Systems at City Facilities Between the City of Encinitas and Countywide Mechanical Systems, Inc. for an additional $21,904 and not to exceed total contract of $498,259 (Attachment 1 of the agenda report).
2020-12-09 Item 08D Rejection of Bids Mechanical Systems Maintenance
8E.
Acceptance of a California Office of Emergency Services (Cal OES) Type VI Fire Engine. Contact Person: Management Analyst Yum
Accept the Cal OES Type VI fir engine and authorize the Fire Chief on behalf of the City of Encinitas to sign the Assignment of Equipment Form, and Agreement for Temporary Transfer Vehicular Equipment covering the transfer of Cal OES Fire Engine Number 6613 to the Encinitas Fire Department (Attachment 1 of the agenda report).
2020-12-09 Item 08E Acceptance of a Cal OES Type VI Fire Engine
8F.
Amendment No.3 for As Needed Maintenance and General Services Agreement with Design Builders. Contact Person: Park Operations Manager Saul
City Council authorizes the City Manager to execute Amendment No. 3 with Design Builders for As Needed Maintenance and General Services, in conjunction with the City Attorney in substantial form as contained in Attachment 1 of the agenda report, increasing the agreement by $94,500 for a three-year agreement term not to exceed $334,500. The total agreement shall not exceed $554,500 for the six-year term.
2020-12-09 Item 08F Amendment No 3 for As Needed Maintenance and General Services Agreement with Deisgn Builders
8G.
Amendment to agreement with Specialty Mowing Services, Inc. for Citywide abatement services. Contact Person: Field Supervisor Tobin
1) Authorize the City Manager, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute Amendment One to the Citywide Abatement Services Agreement in substantial form between the City of Encinitas and Specialty Mowing Services, Inc. to include additional locations to be maintained and minor adjustments to existing areas serviced for a six-year total amount not to exceed $1,170,254 (Attachment 1 of the agenda report); and 2) Approve Resolution 2020-103 titled "A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Fiscal Year 2020-21 Budget" (Attachment 2 of the agenda report).
2020-12-09 Item 08G Amendment to Agreement with Specialty Mowing Services
8H.
Report on the Financial Results for Fiscal Year 2019-20. Contact Person: Assistant Finance Director Gallup
1) Approve and adopt the actual ending fund balances for FY 2019-20 as the beginning fund balances for FY 2020-21 (Attachment 1, Column 8 of the agenda report); 2) Approve the revised Schedule A, "Revised Budget Summary FY 2020-21," presented in Attachment 4 of the agenda report; 3) Receive the Capital Improvement Program End of Year Status Report (Attachment 5 of the agenda report); and 4) Adopt Resolution 2020-100 authorizing a) Fund balance transfer in the amount of $3,601,869 from the General Fund budget carryover to the Capital Improvement Fund 401 and appropriations of $2,638,869 to the North Coast Highway 101 Streetscape Project (CS04D) and $963,000 to the El Portal Pedestrian/Bike Underpass Project (CS16F).
2020-12-09 Item 08H Report on the Financial Results for Fiscal Year 2019-20
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
10.
ACTION ITEMS Public Comments will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
10A.
Introduction of City Council Ordinance No. 2020-09, which proposes amendments to Title 30 (Zoning) of the Encinitas Municipal Code and the Local Coastal Plan to implement recent changes to State Density Bonus law, and incorporate Planning Commission recommendations. Additionally, this ordinance includes a housing program to provide an increased density bonus to incentivize the development of additional affordable housing as an alternative to the 50 percent density bonus provided in Assembly Bill 2345. Contact Person: Planner IV Zornes
Introduce draft Ordinance No 2020-09 titled, "An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, Adopting Amendments to Chapter 30.16.020(C) (Density Bonus Regulations) of the Encinitas Municipal Code to be Consistent with State Law" (Attachment 1 of the agenda report).
2020-12-09 Item 10A Density Bonus Ordinance Intro
2020-12-09 Item 10A - Attachment 1 - Draft Density Bonus Ordinance 2020-09
2020-12-09 Item 10A - Attachment 2 - PC Reso 2020-23
2020-12-09 Item 10A - Attachment 3 - Revisiting California's Density Bonus Law
2020-12-09 Item 10 A - Attachment 4 - AB-2345
2020-12-09 Item 10A - Attachment 5 - Density Bonus Calculation Chart
10B.
Provide $75,000 of additional CARES funding for small business assistance through a donation to the Encinitas Small Business Support Fund administered by the Cardiff-by-the-Sea Foundation. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Piatt
Approve a donation of $75,000 of additional CARES funding for small business assistance through a donation to the Encinitas Small Business Support Fund administered by the Cardiff-by-the-Sea Foundation.
2020-12-09 Item 10B CARES Funding Small Business Support
11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS - NONE
12.
COUNCIL MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM - NONE
13.

Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
